title: Comparative radar chart
intent: Compare current and target profiles across six qualitative dimensions on one fixed radial scale.

ai.create: Create a comparative radar chart with two keyed six-point profiles, a fixed zero-to-one-hundred radial scale, polygon grid rings, and sparse angle labels.
ai.maintain: Update either profile while preserving metric order, series identity, the fixed radial domain, closed D3 curves, and shared guide geometry.
